inventory_rationale: Every function of the running prototype: the accepted public operations, the route handlers of the three external operations, and the private helpers of each module. Signatures are taken from the prototype's code.

functions.purpose: Load runtime settings.
A folder inside the object's root, written relative to it.
The connections file read whole, in the form A5 rule 7 decides.
Load connections.
The record as it stands now: a confirmation the agent cleared stops the next operation.
The resolved path of the photo folder, the path whose containment below the root was checked.
Syncthing's temporary and bookkeeping names, its conflict copies, and the phone's trash.
The folder at an absolute path, opened one component at a time from the file system root without following a link at any of them.
Read one regular file of an opened folder with the metadata of the same opened file. A link is not followed, and a pipe swapped in cannot make the read wait.
The format whose signature the leading bytes carry (A1 order 6).
A scan that cannot see a whole subfolder must not look complete.
The modification time in whole microseconds, earlier fractions dropped.
Each regular file below an opened folder, in scan order, with the descriptor of its folder; each subfolder is opened from its parent without following a link.
The status of one listed file, judged by the bytes and the metadata of the file opened in its folder.
Every file of the folder in scan order, judged by the folder alone.
The segments of a name a scan could report, or None for any other name.

One file as a scan would judge it, with the bytes that were judged; None when there is no such file. Its folders are opened one by one without following a link, and the file is opened in the last of them.
To naive utc.
The camera's UTC offset, or None when it is absent or impossible.
Parse exif moment.
Photo moment.
A clean JPEG: upright, at most 2000 px, with no metadata of the original.
The body of the Portal's photo.publish. A photo stays hidden until the owner shows it.
Synchronise one folder to disk.
Create the missing folders below an installed root with a decided mode; with durable, synchronise each new folder in its parent.
Write a complete file or none, through a fresh exclusive temporary file renamed into place; with durable_folder a failed synchronisation of the folder fails the write.
A record that cannot be trusted is never taken for an absent one.
The record at its address. Only a missing entry is an absent record: a link, even a dangling one, a record of another form and a record naming another project or source are all refused.
Write record.
Placement path.
Mark path.
Store path.
Project lock.
Write the image where the Portal reads it and return its reference.
Read placement.
Write placement.
Read mark.
Write mark.
Require source id.
Photo folder.
The scan's item: what the folder says, completed by what was already delivered.
Scan project photos.
Failed.
Place.
Place one photo. A repeat returns the first result; a failure says why.
Mark outcome.
Remember the Portal photo a placed source became; the Portal cannot answer this later.
The bearer token, from a file only its owner can read.
The context of the operations from the run settings, refusing a start with an invalid connections file or an unknown time zone.
Start the service on the loopback interface and return the exit status of the process.
Deterministic FastAPI app factory binding the context and the token into app state and the four routes to their handlers.
The credential of the single Authorization field with the Bearer scheme, as http_router_backend/v1 emits it.
Table handler of the health route; delegates to answer_health.
The health answer with the status ok.
The credential of the single Authorization field with the Bearer scheme compared without regard to case (A5 rule 1); raises AuthenticationRequired otherwise.
Compare a presented credential with the token whole and in constant time; raises AuthenticationRequired when they differ.
The project id in its canonical UUID spelling (A5 rule 9); raises DelivererError with invalid_request otherwise.
The one row of REFUSAL_ANSWERS whose code is the given refusal code.
The M08 answer of one refusal code, with the status and detail of its row from _refusal_row.
The body of a delivery read as JSON and judged against the request form of A3 rule 4; raises DelivererError with invalid_request otherwise.
The body of a mark read as JSON and judged against the request form with the photo_id of A4 rule 2; raises DelivererError with invalid_request otherwise.
Canonical irregular handler of the scan route: token, project id, then scan_project_photos; every refusal is answered as M08.

Canonical irregular handler of the delivery route: token, then the body read as JSON and judged against DeliverRequest with the project id, then deliver_project_photo; every refusal is answered as M08. It is a coroutine because reading the body is.

Canonical irregular handler of the mark route: token, then the body judged against PublishedRequest with the project id, then mark_photo_published; every refusal is answered as M08. It is a coroutine because reading the body is.
